/* CSS placed here will be applied to all skins */
/* force the display of the contents of the section */
#p-googleadsense .body {
	display:block !important;
}
/* Option 1: hide the header */
#p-googleadsense h3 {
	display:none;
}
/* Option 2: just hide the arrow in the header */
#p-googleadsense h3 {
	background:none !important;
}

#footer { display:none; }

$wgHooks['SkinTemplateSetupPageCss'][] = 'wfHideVariousTabsFromAnonymous';
 
function wfHideVariousTabsFromAnonymous( &$hidetabcss ) {
	global $wgUser;
 
	if ( !$wgUser->isLoggedIn() ) {
		$hidetabcss .= 'li#ca-history, li#ca-viewsource, li#ca-edit, li#ca-talk, .vectorMenu { display: none; }';
	}
 
	return true;
}
